pngtuberRemix.isConnected.description: Tells whether Cuebot is connected to PNGTuber Remix right now.

pngtuberRemix.setState.description: Switches your PNGTuber Remix avatar to another state, like pressing its state button. Capital letters are fixed for you when Cuebot knows the state.

parameters.state: The state's name, or its number (1 is the first state button).

pngtuberRemix.setState.returns: The name of the state now showing.

pngtuberRemix.getState.description: Asks PNGTuber Remix which avatar state is showing right now.
pngtuberRemix.getState.returns: An object with name and number (1 is the first), or null when PNGTuber Remix has no states yet.

pngtuberRemix.getStates.description: Lists the avatar states Cuebot last read (on connect, every few seconds while the checks are on, and after Reload).
pngtuberRemix.getStates.returns: A list of objects with number, name and current (true for the one showing).

pngtuberRemix.getSprites.description: Reads the sprites of your PNGTuber Remix model fresh.
pngtuberRemix.getSprites.returns: A list of objects with name, id, visible, parentId, children (names of the sprites attached directly) and attached (how many are attached, also through others).

pngtuberRemix.setVisibility.description: Shows, hides or toggles a sprite. PNGTuber Remix does the same to everything attached to it.

parameters.sprite: The sprite's exact name (or its sprite id).
parameters.visible: Optional. true to show, false to hide, "toggle" (the default) for the opposite of now.

pngtuberRemix.setVisibility.returns: True when it is now visible, false when hidden.

pngtuberRemix.isVisible.description: Asks PNGTuber Remix whether a sprite is visible right now.

parameters.sprite: The sprite's exact name (or its sprite id).

pngtuberRemix.pressKey.description: Presses one of your PNGTuber Remix key binds without touching the keyboard: sprites bound to that key toggle, and sprites with it as their hide key hide.

parameters.key: The key as Godot writes it, for example A, 1, F5 or Space.

pngtuberRemix.pressKey.returns: A list of what it did, like "Hat (Toggle)"; empty when no sprite uses that key.

pngtuberRemix.throw.description: Throws things at your avatar from your PNGTuber Remix throwables. The amount is lowered to the card's Most per throw.

parameters.item: Optional. The name of one throwable image; empty for random ones.
parameters.amount: Optional. How many. Empty: 1 named item, or PNGTuber Remix's own amount for random ones.
parameters.variance: Optional. How much the throws vary; empty uses PNGTuber Remix's own setting.
parameters.bothSides: Optional. true or false to throw from both sides; empty uses PNGTuber Remix's own setting.

pngtuberRemix.throw.returns: How many were sent, or null when PNGTuber Remix chose the amount.
